guide.title: How to Play
guide.intro: Grow your territory and switch places with another player at the right moment.
guide.moveBody: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Claim territory as you cross the floor.
guide.switchBody: Press 1–8 to switch places with that player. Timing is everything.
guide.skillBody: Press Space to use your selected movement skill. Watch its cooldown.
guide.taggerBody: Avoid the tagger and stay inside the shrinking boundary. Keep an eye on the HUD.
